Features Command Central Control Solarshield Frameless Privacy Glass Collossus Powercore Chassis Auto-Level Ground Control King Bed Power-Clean Dishwasher Loft Room with Sofa and Bunk More About This RV Rugged capability meets residential comfort in the all-new Forest River Wolverine, available only at Blue Compass RV. Built on the Colossus Powercore Chassis with Auto-Level Ground Control, Solarshield frameless privacy glass, and an 88-inch Lumi-Rail brake light system, the Wolverine is engineered to go farther and stay longer. Inside, you'll find true home-away-from-home living: a king bed, 19 cu. ft. refrigerator, Power-Clean dishwasher, dual 18K Coolstream A/C units, and an intuitive Command Center to control it all. Choose from two floorplans built for how you travel. The Wolverine 32JF (35' 11', sleeps 4) is the ideal couple's coach with room for guests, while the Wolverine 36BC (43' 10', sleeps 9) delivers full-family capacity without compromise.
